RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the July 31, 2006/Sravana 9, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Development of North-Eastern Region; Earth Sciences; Food
Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law and Justice;
Mines; Minority Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions —20
Health hazards of asbestos mining
*101. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of MINES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Bureau
of Mines has conducted study on the health
hazards of asbestos mines workers of
Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the recommendations thereof;
(c) whether the study recommended for
lifting of ban on asbestos leasing; and
(d) if so, the details of action taken/
proposed to be taken to implement these
recommendations including the time-frame
for implementation?
Criteria for deemed university
*102. SHRI JANARDHANA POOJARY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria for conferring 'deemed
university' status on an unaided institute;
(b) whether a regular university and a
'deemed university' enjoy same powers,
privileges and are similar in all respects;
(c) whether once conferred the 'deemed
university' status, such institutes are out
of the control of State Government and are
free to prescribe their own fee and course
structures;
(d) whether considering the high fees
charged by such universities, UGC is
contemplating to introduce uniform fee and
course structures for all such universities;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
National Electricity Policy
*103. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Central Government have
formulated/notified any National
Electricity Policy (NEC);

33
(b) if so, the salient features thereof;
and
(c) the steps Government have taken,
till date, to ensure availability of cheap,
environment friendly, good quality power
to common people in the country?
Setting up of special radar for
monitoring cyclone in Paradip Port of
Orissa
*104. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a special radar for
monitoring cyclone is proposed to be set
up in Paradip Port in Orissa to prevent/
mitigate natural disasters;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether weather station sites have
been selected to augment the network of
observation in Orissa; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Seats in professional, medical and
engineering courses
*105. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of students passing out
Class 12 in Science streams from CBSE
Board during the last three years, year-wise;
(b) the annual increase in seats in
professional, medical and engineering
courses during the corresponding period;
(c) whether the gap between number of
Science students passing out of schools and
seats available for medical and engineering
courses has increased over the years;
(d) if so, the steps being taken to
drastically remove the shortage of seats
vis-a-vis increasing demand for such
courses; and
(e) whether Government have looked
into these issues, and if so, the findings
thereof?
Rules for appointment of Judges in
High Court and Supreme Court
*106. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of rules governing
appointment of Judges of High Court and
Supreme Court before 1993 and the existing
rules in this regard; and
(b) whether Government propose to
switch over to the earlier rules of 1993 and
if so, the reasons therefor?
Setting up of Food Research Institute
at Konni in Kerala
*107. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Kerala has
approached the Centre for assistance and
help for setting up an Indigenous Food
Research Institute at Konni on a 114 acre
campus;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal;
and
(c) the decision of Government on this
proposal?

34
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Withdrawal of subsidy on power in
Delhi
*108. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to withdraw the subsidy on
power in Delhi;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that private
companies are selling the power at double
of its cost in Delhi; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

post of Directors are vacant in National
Aluminium Company (NALCO) situated
in Orissa;

 Energy Sources; Power; Science and Technology;

Total number of questions — 155
129
Funds for economic development of
NER
555. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds released/utilised
under various schemes and programmes
implemented by his Ministry for economic
development of the North-Eastern Region
during the last three years, year-wise, State-
wise and Scheme-wise; and
(b) the details and current status of
proposals pertaining to NER pending with
Government?
Socio-economic development of NER
556. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
specified 'thrust areas' for the socio-
economic development of North-Eastern
region;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
formulated any plan for the development/
extension of road and railway network in
this region;
(d) whether Government have also any
specific strategy to develop domestic and
international tourism in this region; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Projects under NLCPR
557. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of the projects proposed
by State Government of Tripura to be taken
up under NLCPR during the year 2005-06
and 2006-07;
(b) the projects accepted and the
amount earmarked;
(c) the projects not accepted; and
(d) the reasons for not accepting the
projects?

130
Electricity from sea-waves
†558. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to generate electricity from sea-waves in
different regions of the country;
(b) if so, the schemes formulated in this
regard and the estimated expenditure likely
to be incurred on the same; and
(c) the quantum of electricity likely to
be generated from this scheme in next 3-4
years?
Setting up of food zones
559. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a plan has
been formulated for setting up of 20
Integrated Food Zones (IFZs), to give a
thrust to the farm sector reforms;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the specific areas/locations identified, State-
wise, to establish the Integrated Food Zones
and infrastructural facilities proposed to
be created, the pattern of funding decided
for the various projects and the time-frame
fixed therefor; and
(c) the criteria evolved for selection of
the specific regions/locations for the food
zones?
Food processing installed capacity in
the country
 560. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the food processing installed
capacity in the country;
(b) the percentage of the fruits
processed in the country;
(c) the wastage of fruits produced in
the country annually and the reasons for
the same;
(d) whether Government have any plan
to encourage processing of such fruits all
over the country to stop the wastage; and
(e) the details of the plan for the next
five years?
Capacity of cold storage and food
processing units in the country
561. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have prepared
any action plan to increase the capacity of
existing cold storage and food processing
units in the country including Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of such units in various States
as on date and the details of units Government
propose to set up during 2005-06 in the country,
State-wise; and
(d) the funds allocated for the purpose
during the current financial year?
Proposal for establishment of food
parks in Andhra Pradesh
562. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had received
any proposal from the Andhra Pradesh
Government for establishment of Food
Processing Parks in the State;

(b) if so, whether the State Government
has furnished the information required by
Government;
(c) if so, the reasons for not considering
these proposals till now; and
(d) the time by when Government are
likely to clear the said proposals?
Functioning of Food Testing
